body.label: Target
body.html: Self or a willing ally within 2 units beside a mundane restraint or obstacle.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one ordinary Movement penalty from a mundane restraint or terrain until the start of your next turn. The target may move 2 units.

surges.html: Both you and the willing ally receive the suppression and movement.

rider.title: Contingency - Evasion
rider.html: When a pursuer voluntarily crosses the target's starting space, it is Slowed 2 until your next turn and cannot make movement Reactions during that move.
